name: the-frontend-strikes-back
description: 2026 talk on 'The Frontend Strikes Back: WebMCP and The Agent-Ready Browser'

scripts.cdp:talk: if pgrep -f 'tfsb-chrome-[t]alk' >/dev/null; then if curl -sf -m 2 127.0.0.1:$npm_package_config_cdp_talk_port/json/version >/dev/null; then echo "talk Chrome already running on :$npm_package_config_cdp_talk_port"; else echo "a talk Chrome is running, but not on :$npm_package_config_cdp_talk_port. Quit it (pkill -f tfsb-chrome-talk) and run this again." >&2; exit 1; fi; else open -na 'Google Chrome' --args --remote-debugging-port=$npm_package_config_cdp_talk_port --remote-allow-origins='*' --user-data-dir=$HOME/.cache/tfsb-chrome-talk --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check http://localhost:3000; fi
scripts.format: npm run lint && npm run pretty
